newsitem.title: USA: Petrolite says Maritz resigns as director.
newsitem.headline: Petrolite says Maritz resigns as director.

text.p: Petrolite Corp said Friday that it received a letter from William Maritz in which he resigned as a member of its board.

The letter quotes Maritz' difference of opinion with the company's largest shareholder, Wm. S. Barnickel & Co. "I simply do not agree with the actions taken by Wm. S. Barnickel & Co to replace five members of our present board and then pursue a sale or merger of Petrolite," Maritz said in the letter.
"Given this difference of opinion, I don't feel I can continue to serve in good conscience on the Petrolite board," Maritz wrote in his letter.

Maritz was one of the members of the company's special committee formed in June 1996 to review its strategic options. The remaining members are Jerry Davis, Louis Fernandez, Richard O'Shields, Brian Rushton and Joseph Williams.

Petrolite, a specialty chemical company, also said it received a request on behalf of Wm. S. Barnickel & Co to fix a record date in connection with its proposed consent solicitation to remove and replace five Petrolite directors.
